community_posts_scope_school_check.name: community_posts_scope_school_check
community_posts_scope_school_check.value: ("community_posts"."scope" = 'school' and "community_posts"."school_id" is not null) or ("community_posts"."scope" = 'platform' and "community_posts"."school_id" is null)

registration_requests_school_status_chec.name: registration_requests_school_status_check
registration_requests_school_status_chec.value: ("registration_requests"."status" = 'draft' and "registration_requests"."school_id" is null) or ("registration_requests"."status" <> 'draft' and "registration_requests"."school_id" is not null)
